entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in C.T. No.41 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M,
Bhubaneswar arising out of Cyber Crime and Economic Offence Bhubaneswar P.S. Case No.02 of 2023 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 419/420/468/120-B/34 IPC and Section 66-C/66-D of the I.T Act.

entities.text: Cyber Crime and Economic Offence Bhubaneswar P.S. Case No.02 of 2023
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Special Judge (CBI), Court No.1- cum-Addl. Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar by order dated 02.03.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text: Special Judge (CBI), Court No.1- cum-Addl. Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 4.2.2023 on the allegation of duping the Informant a sum of Rs.75,855/- through online transaction.

5. It is further submitted that in the meanwhile charge sheet has been filed on 11.04.2023 keeping the investigation open under Section 173(8) Cr.P.C.
6.

Referring to the same, learned counsel for the State submits that since investigation has kept open and the offence being an online fraud, releasing the Petitioner at this stage would derail the ongoing investigation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Keeping in view the nature of accusation and the punishment prescribed, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

8. To allay the legitimate apprehension of the learned Public Prosecutor regarding ensuring the presence of the Petitioner during trial since he does not belong to the State of Odisha, additionally it is directed that one of the family members of the Petitioner shall execute the P.R bond in addition to the sureties in terms of the order of the learned Court in seisin and his criminal antecedents from P.S. Jadavpur, Kolkata, West Bengal shall also be called for.
9.
If it comes to fore that the Petitioner has any criminal antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.
10. The BLAPL thus stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge PKS Signed by: PRADEEP KUMAR SWAIN Saikat Paul vs State Of Odisha ....
